payload.question: Sorry to ask again: plumb does not carry your answer from session plumb-d2 into this one (a plumb defect I'll report), and it blocks the landing until you pick here. "One host-neutral core gives every host the same turn" (SR-282) now lists Claude Code, Codex and Hermes, no longer Pi. Your 2026-10-17 answer (DEC-178): "No: they add beside them; ... SR-313 reaches every host as SR-282 requires ...". Does your answer still hold for what it says now?
